answer: Proposal: weight is attracted, not held. Reward and votes count only arms-length inflows — value from funding-roots disjoint from its own ancestry — decaying to zero each epoch. The chain traces each payment's ancestry, a prism: mixed flows exit as separate bands; a farm's all land in one. Masks paying each other are yarrow — one rootstock, many heads — so only roots count. Faking a root means truly placing coin in another's vault and buying it back each epoch at their price — honest linear rent, profitable only when earnings top the skim. Seams: mixers blur the bands; partners who rebate.
